prior_exposure: Root previously read all 4,407 reports in the original corrective run and knows the historical 34 corrections and aggregate focused-queue/reader counts. First focused-reader discovery summaries exposed some examples and wording. This is an additional personally authored full-source reread, not first-ever blinding. Neither focused reader's case-specific source states, proposals, current effective labels or comparisons were opened for this pass. Only the neutral manifest and this first ten-report packet were opened, besides the frozen rubric.
